a9:T22789,<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-default github-dark-default" style="--shiki-light:#1f2328;--shiki-dark:#e6edf3;--shiki-light-bg:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0d1117" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">#!/usr/bin/env node</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E">/**</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * ACP bridge for the Agent Workspace template.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * Browsers cannot spawn processes or touch your files, so this small Node</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * server sits between the web UI and any Agent Client Protocol agent:</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   browser ── WebSocket (JSON-RPC) ──► acp-bridge ── stdio (ndjson) ──► agent</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * - The browser sends `_bridge/spawn` with the agent's command, then speaks</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   plain ACP (initialize, session/new, session/prompt, …); the bridge pipes it</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   to the agent's stdin and pipes the agent's stdout back.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * - Client-side methods the agent calls (fs/read_text_file,</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   fs/write_text_file, terminal/*) are answered here, inside --root only.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   Terminal output and file writes are mirrored to the browser as `_bridge/*`</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   notifications so the UI can show live output and offer Undo.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> * - `_bridge/list_files`, `_bridge/read_file`, `_bridge/write_file` and</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#6E7781;--shiki-dark:#8B949E"> *   `_bridge/exec` power the explorer, the edited-files Undo and the terminal.</span></span>

ab:T3206,<pre class="shiki shiki-themes github-light-default github-dark-default" style="--shiki-light:#1f2328;--shiki-dark:#e6edf3;--shiki-light-bg:#ffffff;--shiki-dark-bg:#0d1117" tabindex="0"><code><span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold"># ACP bridge</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">The Agent Workspace (installed as the home page, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`app/page.tsx`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">) is an [</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF">Agent Client Protocol</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">](</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-light-text-decoration:underline;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3;--shiki-dark-text-decoration:underline">https://agentclientprotocol.com/get-started/introduction</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">) client. It starts on an offline demo agent. To drive a real agent (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI or any other ACP agent) run this bridge next to your code:</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```bash</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">node</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF"> server/acp-bridge.mjs</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF"> --root</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0A3069;--shiki-dark:#A5D6FF"> /path/to/your/repo</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">It prints an address and a token:</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">ACP bridge ready</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  workspace  /path/to/your/repo</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  address    ws://127.0.0.1:8787</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">  token      3f9c…</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">Open the workspace, go to </span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold">**Settings → Agents**</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, paste the address and token, pick an agent and press </span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold">**Connect**</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>

<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--host &#x3C;addr>`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`ACP_BRIDGE_HOST`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`127.0.0.1`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--token &#x3C;secret>`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`ACP_BRIDGE_TOKEN`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | random, printed at start |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--verbose`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`ACP_BRIDGE_VERBOSE=1`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | off |</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">Needs Node 18+ and the </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`ws`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> package (installed with the template).</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold">## Agents</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| Agent | Command | Sign-in |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| --- | --- | --- |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| Claude Code | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`npx -y @zed-industries/claude-code-acp`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`claude /login`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, or </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`ANTHROPIC_API_KEY`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> in the agent's environment |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| Codex | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`npx -y @zed-industries/codex-acp`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | ChatGPT login or </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`OPENAI_API_KEY`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> |</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">| Gemini CLI | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`gemini --experimental-acp`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> | </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`gemini`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> login or </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`GEMINI_API_KEY`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> |</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">Add any other agent in Settings with its command, arguments and environment variables.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold">## What it does</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">browser ── WebSocket (JSON-RPC) ──► acp-bridge ── stdio (ndjson) ──► agent</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">```</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">-</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF"> `_bridge/spawn`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> starts the agent; every other ACP message is piped through unchanged.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">-</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> The agent's client-side calls are answered by the bridge, confined to </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`--root`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">: </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`fs/read_text_file`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`fs/write_text_file`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`terminal/create`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`terminal/output`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`terminal/wait_for_exit`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`terminal/kill`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`terminal/release`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">-</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> Terminal output and file writes are mirrored to the page (</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`_bridge/terminal_output`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`_bridge/terminal_exit`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`_bridge/fs_write`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">) for live output and Undo.</span></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#953800;--shiki-dark:#FFA657">-</span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF"> `_bridge/list_files`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`_bridge/read_file`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">, </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`_bridge/write_file`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> and </span><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF">`_bridge/exec`</span><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3"> power the explorer, @mentions, Undo and the terminal panel.</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#0550AE;--shiki-light-font-weight:bold;--shiki-dark:#79C0FF;--shiki-dark-font-weight:bold">## Security</span></span>
<span class="line"></span>
<span class="line"><span style="--shiki-light:#1F2328;--shiki-dark:#E6EDF3">Anyone with the token can run commands as you inside the workspace root. The bridge listens on 127.0.0.1 and refuses WebSocket connections without the token. Do not expose the port to other machines.</span></span></code></pre>8c:["$","$L97","registry/base-nova/templates/agent-workspace/server/README.md",{"html":"$ab","title":"registry/base-nova/templates/agent-workspace/server/README.md","language":"markdown","lineNumbers":true,"maxHeight":420}]
